en.title: Birth Certificate Application Form (PSA)
en.purpose: Use this form to ask the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) for a certified copy of a birth certificate.
en.who_files: Anyone of legal age (18 and above) can request. If you are not the person named in the certificate, bring an authorization letter and valid IDs to show you may request it.
prepare: Your valid government-issued ID
If you are a representative: your own valid ID and a signed authorization letter, as the outlet requires
Details of the person in the certificate: full name, date and place of birth, and parents' names
The BReN (Birth Reference Number), if you have one
sections: Type of request (copy issuance, authentication, viewable online, and others)
Person's/Child's information
Purpose of your request (for example claiming benefits or a loan, employment, school, passport or travel)
Requester's details and signature
Privacy notice
en.where_to_submit: Give it to the PSA Civil Registry System (CRS) outlet where you make your request.
en.reminder: ⚠️ Fill it in using UPPERCASE / PRINTED LETTERS and write clearly. Write the mother's maiden name (her name before marriage).

forms.form_name: COMELEC Application for Voter Registration (CEF-1 Revised 2026)

en.title: Voter Registration Form (COMELEC CEF-1)
en.purpose: This is COMELEC's voter application form. Use it to register as a voter, or to transfer, reactivate, change your name or correct your record, update your signature or photo, or ask to be included or reinstated in the list of voters.
en.who_files: Filipino citizens who want to register or change their voter record. Registration is for ages 18 and above; ages 15 to 17 sign a separate oath for the Katipunan ng Kabataan.
prepare: A valid government-issued ID (Barangay ID or Barangay Certification with photo and signature IS accepted; ⚠️ Cedula / Community Tax Certificate and Police Clearance are NOT accepted under COMELEC Res. No. 10963)
Your personal details: full name, date and place of birth, address, and how long you have lived there
For a transfer or reactivation: your existing voter details, such as your precinct number if you know it
For a change of name or a correction: the supporting document the form asks for, such as a court order or PSA certificate
sections: Type of application: registration, transfer, reactivation, change of name or correction, updating, or inclusion/reinstatement
Part 1: your personal information
Help you may need if you are an indigenous person, cannot read or write, or have a disability
Part 2 (Oath, Notice & Consent): ⚠️ DO NOT sign or put thumbmarks here at home — sign ONLY in front of the Election Officer
Part 3 & Part 4 (ERB / Election Officer Action): ⚠️ Leave completely BLANK — for COMELEC personnel only
en.where_to_submit: Submit it in person to the Office of the Election Officer (OEO) of your city or municipality.
en.reminder: ⚠️ CRITICAL WARNING: Do NOT sign or affix thumbprints in Part 2 (Oath) at home! It must be signed ONLY in front of the Election Officer, and leave Part 3/Part 4 blank. Filing is FREE (₱0.00 under RA 11032); however, if your case requires a separate notarized Affidavit, prepare ₱30.00 for Documentary Stamp Tax (DST) plus ₱50–₱100 for private notary fees.

tl.title: Voter Registration Form (COMELEC CEF-1)
tl.purpose: Ito ang application form ng COMELEC para sa mga botante. Gamitin ito para magparehistro bilang botante, o para mag-transfer, mag-reactivate, magpalit ng pangalan o magtama ng record, mag-update ng pirma o litrato, o hilingin na maisama o maibalik ang pangalan mo sa listahan ng mga botante.
tl.who_files: Mga Pilipinong gustong magparehistro o magbago ng voter record. Ang pagpaparehistro ay para sa edad 18 pataas; ang edad 15 hanggang 17 ay pipirma sa hiwalay na panunumpa para sa Katipunan ng Kabataan.
prepare: Valid government-issued ID (Tinatanggap ang Barangay ID o Barangay Certification na may litrato at pirma; ⚠️ HINDI tinatanggap ang Cedula at Police Clearance ayon sa COMELEC Res. No. 10963)
Personal na detalye mo: buong pangalan, petsa at lugar ng kapanganakan, address, at kung gaano ka na katagal nakatira doon
Para sa transfer o reactivation: ang kasalukuyan mong voter details, tulad ng precinct number kung alam mo
Para sa pagpapalit ng pangalan o pagtatama: ang supporting document na hinihingi ng form, tulad ng court order o PSA certificate
sections: Uri ng application: pagpaparehistro, transfer, reactivation, pagpapalit ng pangalan o pagtatama, updating, o inclusion/reinstatement
Part 1: ang personal information mo
Tulong na maaaring kailangan mo kung ikaw ay katutubo, hindi nakakabasa o nakakasulat, o may kapansanan
Part 2 (Oath, Notice at Consent): ⚠️ HUWAG pirmahan o lagyan ng thumbmark sa bahay — pumirma LAMANG sa harap ng Election Officer
Part 3 at Part 4 (Para sa Election Officer / ERB): ⚠️ Iwang BLANGKO — para lamang sa kawani ng COMELEC
tl.where_to_submit: Ipasa nang personal sa Office of the Election Officer (OEO) ng lungsod o bayan mo.
tl.reminder: ⚠️ MAHALAGANG BABALA: HUWAG pirmahan o lagyan ng thumbmark ang Part 2 (Panunumpa) sa bahay! Pumirma LAMANG sa harap ng Election Officer, at iwang blangko ang Part 3/Part 4. LIBRE (₱0.00 sa ilalim ng RA 11032) ang pagpasa ng form; ngunit kung kailangan ng hiwalay na notarized Affidavit, maghanda ng ₱30.00 para sa Documentary Stamp Tax (DST) at ₱50–₱100 para sa notaryo.

ceb.title: Voter Registration Form (COMELEC CEF-1)
ceb.purpose: Kini ang application form sa COMELEC para sa mga botante. Gamiton kini sa pag-rehistro isip botante, o sa pag-transfer, pag-reactivate, pag-usab sa ngalan o pagtul-id sa record, pag-update sa pirma o litrato, o pag-hangyo nga maapil o mabalik ang imong ngalan sa lista sa mga botante.
ceb.who_files: Mga Pilipino nga gustong mo-rehistro o mag-usab sa ilang voter record. Ang pag-rehistro kay para sa edad 18 pataas; ang edad 15 hangtod 17 mopirma sa lahi nga panumpa para sa Katipunan ng Kabataan.
prepare: Valid government-issued ID (Dawaton ang Barangay ID o Barangay Certification nga naay litrato ug pirma; ⚠️ DILI dawaton ang Cedula ug Police Clearance ubos sa COMELEC Res. No. 10963)
Imong personal nga detalye: tibuok ngalan, petsa ug lugar nga natawhan, address, ug pila na ka tuig o bulan ka nagpuyo didto
Para sa transfer o reactivation: imong karon nga voter details, sama sa precinct number kung kabalo ka
Para sa pag-usab sa ngalan o pagtul-id: ang supporting document nga gipangayo sa form, sama sa court order o PSA certificate
sections: Klase sa application: pag-rehistro, transfer, reactivation, pag-usab sa ngalan o pagtul-id, updating, o inclusion/reinstatement
Part 1: imong personal information
Tabang nga mahimong kinahanglan nimo kung ikaw usa ka lumad, dili kabasa o kasulat, o naay kakulian sa lawas (PWD)
Part 2 (Panumpa, Notice ug Consent): ⚠️ AYAW pirmahi o butangi og thumbmark sa balay — atubangan ra gyud sa Election Officer kini pirmahan
Part 3 ug Part 4 (Para sa Election Officer / ERB): ⚠️ Pasagdi nga BLANGKO — para ra sa empleyado sa COMELEC
ceb.where_to_submit: Ipasa sa personal didto sa Office of the Election Officer (OEO) sa imong siyudad o lungsod.
ceb.reminder: ⚠️ IMPORTANTE NGA PAHIMANGNO: AYAW pirmahi o butangi og thumbmark ang Part 2 (Panumpa) samtang naa pa sa balay! Pirmahi lang kini atubangan sa Election Officer, ug pasagdi nga blangko ang Part 3/Part 4. LIBRE (₱0.00 ubos sa RA 11032) ang pagpasa niini nga form; apan kung kinahanglan og lahi nga notarized Affidavit, pag-andam og ₱30.00 para sa Documentary Stamp Tax (DST) ug ₱50–₱100 para sa notaryo.

en.title: Supplementary / Updating of Data Form (COMELEC)

en.who_files: Registered voters who are persons with disability, senior citizens or indigenous people, and voters who need help, including those who cannot read or write. An Assistor can help you fill it in.
prepare: Your voter details, such as your name and precinct number if you know it
Your type of disability and the help you need (communication help, visual help, or none)
The name of your indigenous community, if you belong to one
Your Assistor, if you need one: the Assistor fills in a certification on the form

Type of disability
Type of assistance needed on election day
Membership in an Indigenous Cultural Community
Are you willing to vote at an Accessible Polling Place (YES/NO)
Signature or thumbmark of the applicant, and the Assistor's certification

en.reminder: ⚠️ Tick every box that applies to you. Filing this supplementary form is FREE (₱0.00). The Assistor completes the certification part.

en.title: PhilHealth Member Registration Form (PMRF)
en.purpose: Use this form to register as a PhilHealth member and get your PhilHealth Identification Number (PIN), or to update or correct your member record.
en.who_files: People joining PhilHealth for the first time, and existing members who need to update or correct their information.
prepare: A valid government ID or PSA Birth Certificate (Note: if you lack a primary ID and request a Barangay Residency Certificate first, the barangay hall may require a Cedula)
Your full name as it appears in your birth certificate (including mother's maiden name)
Details of your spouse and qualified dependents (unmarried children below 21, or parents 60+ / PWD), if you will declare any
Supporting documents if you are updating dependents or correcting your record, such as a PSA birth or marriage certificate
Proof of income or Sworn Declaration of Income, if it applies to your member type
sections: Purpose: Registration or Updating/Amendment
I. Personal details (write in UPPERCASE / CAPITAL LETTERS and write 'N/A' if not applicable)
II. Address and contact details
III. Declaration of dependents
IV. Member type (for example employed, self-earning, senior citizen, person with disability)
V. Updating/Amendment, if you are changing your record
FOR PHILHEALTH USE ONLY box: ⚠️ Leave completely BLANK (strictly reserved for PhilHealth personnel)
en.where_to_submit: Submit it to the nearest PhilHealth Local Health Insurance Office (LHIO) or PhilHealth Express outlet.
en.reminder: ⚠️ CRITICAL WARNING: Write all entries in UPPERCASE / CAPITAL LETTERS (write 'N/A' if not applicable) and DO NOT write anything inside the 'FOR PHILHEALTH USE ONLY' section. Registration is FREE (₱0.00 under RA 11032); however, if submitting a separate notarized Sworn Declaration or Affidavit, prepare ₱30.00 for Documentary Stamp Tax (DST) plus ₱50–₱100 for private notary fees.

forms.form_name: NCSC Application Form - Octogenarian, Nonagenarian and Centenarian Benefit Program

en.title: Octogenarian, Nonagenarian and Centenarian Benefit Application (NCSC)
en.purpose: Use this form to claim the cash benefit under Republic Act 11982 for senior citizens who reach the milestone ages of 80, 85, 90, 95 and 100.
en.who_files: Filipino senior citizens who reached a milestone age, whether they live in the Philippines or abroad. An authorized representative can apply for them.
prepare: A primary document, such as a PSA Certificate of Live Birth, a Philippine Identification (PhilSys) ID, or a valid Philippine passport
A recent 2x2 ID picture, and a full-body picture if the form asks for it
Names of your children and your designated beneficiary
If you live abroad: the extra documents listed in the form's requirements section
sections: Your NCSC registration reference number (RRN) and OSCA ID number
A. Personal information
B. Family information (children and authorized representatives)
C. Contact information and D. Designated beneficiary
E. How you plan to use the cash gift
F. Certification under oath, with your signature or thumbmark
en.where_to_submit: Apply through your local Office for Senior Citizens Affairs (OSCA) or the National Commission of Senior Citizens (NCSC).
en.reminder: ⚠️ Fill it in completely and correctly. The form is FREE and NOT FOR SALE. The cash gift has to be claimed within one year of reaching the milestone age.

tl.who_files: Mga Pilipinong senior citizen na umabot sa milestone age, nakatira man sa Pilipinas o sa ibang bansa. Puwedeng mag-apply para sa kanila ang isang authorized representative.
prepare: Primary document, tulad ng PSA Certificate of Live Birth, Philippine Identification (PhilSys) ID, o valid na Philippine passport
Bagong 2x2 ID picture, at full-body picture kung hinihingi ng form
Mga pangalan ng mga anak mo at ng designated beneficiary mo
Kung nakatira ka sa ibang bansa: ang mga karagdagang dokumentong nakalista sa requirements section ng form
sections: NCSC registration reference number (RRN) at OSCA ID number mo

E. Paano mo balak gamitin ang cash gift

tl.where_to_submit: Mag-apply sa lokal mong Office for Senior Citizens Affairs (OSCA) o sa National Commission of Senior Citizens (NCSC).
tl.reminder: ⚠️ Punan nang buo at tama. LIBRE at HINDI IPINAGBIBILI ang form na ito. Dapat i-claim ang cash gift sa loob ng isang taon pagkaabot ng milestone age.
